entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-09-04
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Extra sacrificial read in async compound array indexing operations #80147
    Backlog
  • Provide a way for specific DiagnosticAnalyzers to get specific AnalyzerOptions when running analyzers #80143
    18.0
  • Type inference does not conform to collection expressions spec #80142
  • IDE0071 should probably be a performance rule instead of a code style rule #80139
  • Adjusting namespace when moving file deletes explicit anonymous type member names #80133
    Backlog
  • IDE0071 should suggest removing ToString on {ReadOnly}Span<char> for .NET 6+ #80132
  • Signature help doesn't show correct overload when dealing with interpolated string handlers #80131
  • c# intellisense in fuzzy search suddenly become case sensitive #80134
    Backlog

Closed

  • BuildHost crash due to gaps in the solution directory #78889
  • Add tests for MSBuildWorkspace on Windows containing options with quotes in them #71021
    Backlog

Created

  • Review crypto hashes in compiler test plan #80148
    Area-Compilers

    Area-IDE, VSCode

    Area-Compilers
  • Try out jason's ideas #80130
